items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Jim BEEBE on trombone, Barney Bigard, Barrett Deems on drums, Art Hodes on piano and me on cornet.

ctx.x: Yes. Art (Hodes) is on piano. Barrett Deems on drums, he used to be with Louis Armstrong.

items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: So then we started doing Chicago things, and using Chicago men to back guests. So I used different people that would play. And brought in ... Jimmy McPartland ...

ctx.x: Bud, the McPartands -- I guess just Jimmy left -- Bix.
Slowly. Some of them left fast and some took longer to leave.
